title: Canonical finite map is a closed immersion
statement: For every morphism f, point y and n, formalFunctionsFiniteι f y n is a closed immersion.

proof.text: Apply vertical pullback pasting to the defining finite-fibre square and the local base-change square. This proves that formalFunctionsFiniteι is the pullback of Spec of the quotient ring map. The quotient map is surjective, so IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective and MorphismProperty.of_isPullback prove closedness. Neither the module quotient theorem nor the ideal calculation is used for this clause.
